_comment: Everything the Support page shows, in one place. scripts/build-site.ts reads this
file and generates docs/support.html from docs/support.template.html — no donation
value is written in the HTML, so changing an address is an edit here and a re-run of
`npm run build:site`.
EVERY payable value below is a placeholder. Replace each REPLACE_ME with the real
thing before publishing; the build prints a warning listing any that are still unset,
and the page renders them as a visible 'Not set yet' with the copy button disabled
rather than as a payable value.
mpesa.country and mpesa.internationalNote are NOT placeholders — they are the real
copy for the callout under the M-Pesa cards, which tells someone outside Kenya how to
send to an M-Pesa wallet through Wise or Western Union.
cryptoEnabled gates the whole Crypto section. False renders the heading with the
cards blurred behind a "coming soon" overlay, and the addresses are replaced with a
masked value before they ever reach the HTML — a CSS blur hides nothing from View
Source, so the flag must not depend on one. Flip it to true once the addresses and
QR images are real, and the section renders normally with no other change.
Crypto QR images are NOT generated — drop a .webp at each entry's qrImage path
(docs/assets/qr/). Until the file exists the card shows a labelled placeholder frame.
Share captions: captions[0] goes to X, captions[1] to WhatsApp. Facebook and
LinkedIn strip caller-supplied text from their share intents and render the target
page's own og: tags instead, so they receive the URL only — that is their behaviour,
not an omission here.

captions: StreamDock pulls video from thousands of sites and captures live streams in real time — one free, open-source desktop app. Powered by yt-dlp and ffmpeg.
Found a good one: StreamDock, a free open-source desktop app for downloading video and capturing live streams from thousands of sites. Windows and Linux.

mpesa.internationalNote: Outside Kenya? Use Wise, Western Union, or a similar transfer service — you only need my country (Kenya) and phone number above, no signup required on your end. Select Kenya as the destination and mobile wallet / M-Pesa as the delivery method.
